hypothesis: The strongest signals are asymmetric and arrive at different times. A pre-HOT downstream-value shortlist followed by a causal pullback-time severe-loss veto should outperform either decision in isolation.

stage1.representation: Request280 base plus exact 1/3/5-minute ticker history
stage1.selection: top 20% by threshold derived only from outer-fold training candidates

stage2.representation: pullback path prefix plus strictly completed prior-minute context and pre-HOT ticker history
stage2.veto: reject highest 50% predicted severe-risk pullback states using outer-fold training-state threshold

next_if_pass: Freeze the two-stage architecture and validate without retuning on May11-20.
next_if_fail: Test whether pullback-time WAIT/recheck is needed instead of a one-shot ENTER-versus-CASH decision.
